title: Retained Work-Register Multiplicity Erasure, Target-Amplitude Monotonicity, and Preimage Attack Equivalence

scope.multiplicity_variance_leakage: Conditional noiseless secret-readout probability after inverse QFT on the retained work register is 1 / (N * C_A) = 1 / (1 + N * sum_sigma (p_sigma - 1/N)^2)
scope.target_amplitude_monotonicity: For any passive diagonal work contraction |w_sigma| <= 1 and any error vector e, the joint probability P_W(readout -s AND zero) is at most 1/N, and for exact multiplicity erasure w_sigma* = m_min^+ / m_sigma equals (S_+ * m_min^+ / D)^2 / N <= 1/N
scope.chosen_frequency_preimage_equivalence: A preimage oracle returning (b, w) with sigma(b, w) = e_i directly recovers s_masked[i] + theta_e(b, w) mod q in n classical queries
